prototype_disclaimer: Experimental research prototype only. It does not replace Avalanche Canada guidance or field assessment. Model scores are relative indices, not probabilities.

excluded_regimes: cornice fall without a separately documented dry dense-slab event
scientific_scope.negative_label_rule: An unreported avalanche, an unobserved location, or an area outside an explicit complete-search mask is unknown, never a negative label.
scientific_scope.missing_data_rule: Missing terrain, forcing, release, coverage, and observation data remain masked and visible; they are never converted to a safe-looking zero.

required_observations: independent release polygon or release-cell mask
explicit complete-search/detection mask for metrics that require negatives
R.forbidden_target_use: Observed release geometry may be opened only by the scorer after a prediction and all identities have been frozen.

C.prediction_target: terminal dense-flow deposit polygon and/or terminal dense-flow endpoint, conditional on an observed release state
required_observations: release geometry independent of the evaluated deposit or endpoint target
release thickness evidence with metres as the canonical unit
release density evidence with kilograms per cubic metre as the canonical unit
terminal dense-flow deposit or endpoint with component attribution
explicit complete-search/detection mask for metrics that require negatives
C.release_state_rule: Release geometry, thickness, density, and derived initial-condition hash are frozen before any runout target is opened.
C.weather_rule: Weather is recorded for provenance but is not required unless it is an input to the named runout engine.

E.prediction_target: release plus terminal dense-flow deposit and/or terminal dense-flow endpoint
required_observations: terminal dense-flow deposit or endpoint with component attribution
all deterministic release-model inputs with acquisition intervals, units, uncertainty, and spatial representativeness
a predeclared rule linking a release prediction to a runout initial state
explicit complete-search/detection mask for metrics that require negatives

A.description: Surveyed field mapping or reviewed remote sensing with independent interpretation, documented method, complete target coverage, explicit uncertainty, component attribution, and blind annotation.
A.quantitative_use: Eligible only for the component whose target and coverage requirements are met.

B.description: Independently documented terminal dense-flow endpoint or partial component geometry with quantified position uncertainty, but without a complete-search polygon mask.
B.quantitative_use: Endpoint-distance or positive-only metrics only; never binary false-positive or IoU claims.

C.description: Positive avalanche report or geometry lacking sufficient mapping method, blindness, coverage, independence, component attribution, or uncertainty.
C.quantitative_use: Candidate discovery and positive-only characterization only; absence is unlabelled.

quantitative_only_if_all_true: mapping method and source resolution are documented
annotation is independent of the evaluated prediction
annotator was blind to model output
survey footprint and detection limitations are recorded
horizontal uncertainty and confidence are recorded per feature
an annotation-protocol artifact is SHA-256 identified
remote_sensing_acceptance.otherwise: Qualitative development evidence or positive-unlabelled candidate evidence only.

dense_flow_footprint_definition.quantity: peak flow thickness normal to the local slope
dense_flow_footprint_definition.threshold_status: Project-defined evaluation threshold, not a universal physical boundary and not evidence of improved accuracy.
dense_flow_footprint_definition.holdout_rule: The primary threshold and any permitted sensitivity reporting are frozen before a final holdout target is opened and may not be selected from holdout performance.

end_to_end.metrics: Release and runout metrics are reported separately and jointly; a joint result never hides a failed component.

cohort_reporting.aggregation: event-level metrics with median, interquartile range, and bootstrap confidence interval

named_baselines.release: Current deterministic release model in avycore.hazard.risk
named_baselines.conditional_runout_routing: Current alpha-angle routing baseline in avycore.hazard.runout
named_baselines.conditional_runout_dynamic: Current deterministic particle solver in avycore.hazard.runout
named_baselines.comparison_rule: Additional complexity is a candidate, not an accuracy improvement, until it outperforms the named baseline on a protected holdout under this protocol.

uncertainty_ensemble.sampling_rule: Use only predeclared measured bounds or source-supported distributions; missing values are not silently imputed.

grouping_and_partitioning.anti_leakage: No path_group_id or storm_group_id may occur in more than one partition. Mountain grouping is recorded and is kept together when event independence cannot be justified.

inclusion_rules: The event is a dry dense-slab avalanche or can be supported as such by primary evidence.
The source record and every acquired byte are identified by stable URL or DOI, version or acquisition time, size, and SHA-256.
The event time is an explicit UTC instant or bounded UTC interval; unresolved local time-zone semantics make the event ineligible until resolved.
Terrain CRS, units, vertical datum, epoch, transformations, and event-surface mismatch are documented.
Each observation states its mapping method, independence, coverage semantics, resolution, detection limitations, uncertainty, and confidence basis.
Each event satisfies every component-specific input and observation requirement for the profile being scored.
exclusion_rules: Avalanche type or dense-flow component cannot be established.
Source licence does not permit the intended validation use or required attribution cannot be preserved.
Event time, coordinate reference system, units, or coordinate order cannot be resolved.
The candidate depends on an unreported avalanche being treated as a negative.
Required release thickness, density, terrain, forcing, coverage, uncertainty, or component-attribution evidence is missing.
Release evidence is derived from or selected after viewing the evaluated runout target.
The observation was annotated with access to the evaluated model prediction.
The event shares a path or storm group across development and holdout partitions.

acceptance_criteria.release: Report against the current deterministic release baseline; no claim of validation or improvement unless the full protected cohort and uncertainty intervals are reported.
acceptance_criteria.conditional_runout: Report alpha routing and the particle solver as named baselines using the same frozen observed release state; a candidate must be compared event-for-event.
acceptance_criteria.end_to_end: Release and runout must both pass their predeclared component checks; aggregate success cannot compensate for a failed component.
acceptance_criteria.failed_results: A failed result is retained and reported. Parameters and thresholds are never adjusted against a final holdout to force a pass.

prior_evidence_policy.reason: These sources or events were viewed during development before this protocol was frozen.

identity_freeze.observation_manifest_hash: pending before any target is opened by a scorer
